note: the stage admission tape: a row [tick, [hero input]] holds until the next row; the twelve wave spawns are CPU rows and take none. 600 ticks = 10 s at 60. Walk right for four seconds to meet the first slime (it wakes at tick 18 off the right edge and walks in), then a punch at the start of every recovery window (attackCooldownTicks 60) until the tape ends - long enough for hits both ways, a KO and its coin, and the second and third spawns walking in.
